name: glass-sheet
title: Glass Sheet
description: iOS 26 floating glass sheet. Detached by default — it floats inset from the screen edges with big rounded corners — or docked edge-to-edge. It springs up over a fading dim, follows your finger from the grabber or the content, settles on the snap point projected from your release velocity (a fling down dismisses) with a haptic tick, and sizes itself to its content when no snap points are given; taller content scrolls. Real Liquid Glass on iOS 26, material blur on older iOS and web, a readable frosted surface on Android.
